title: Understanding Curve Care+ AI Notes+: Ambient Appointment Listening for SOAP and Templated Notes – Curve Dental
markdown:
[Skip to main content](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51681266670739-Understanding-Curve-Care-AI-Notes-Ambient-Appointment-Listening-for-SOAP-and-Templated-Notes#main-content)

* * *

**Description**

This quick guide provides an overview landing page for the Curve Care+ AI Notes+ feature.

**About**

The Curve Clinical AI Suite provides users the ability to create AI-generated note drafts from recorded provider-patient conversations, real-time clinical charting via hands-free provider voice dictation, and real-time periodontal charting via voice dictation for maximum efficiency. Please visit [**Overview of the Curve Clinical AI Suite - Landing Page**](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50609443817875--Upcoming-Release-Overview-of-the-Curve-Clinical-AI-Suite-Landing-Page) for a full overview of the Curve Care+ AI Clinical Suite.

**Note:** Curve Care+ AI voice transcriptions require users to have Administrator permissions. Permissions can be established in _Roles and permissions_ inside the _Administration_ side panel.

**Contents**

The following sections are included in this quick guide:

- [Section 1](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51681266670739-Understanding-Curve-Care-AI-Notes-Ambient-Appointment-Listening-for-SOAP-and-Templated-Notes#1) \- Overview of Notes+ Ambient Appointment Listening
- [Section 2](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51681266670739-Understanding-Curve-Care-AI-Notes-Ambient-Appointment-Listening-for-SOAP-and-Templated-Notes#2) \- Overview of SOAP Notes With Notes+ (From Sidekick)
- [Section 3](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51681266670739-Understanding-Curve-Care-AI-Notes-Ambient-Appointment-Listening-for-SOAP-and-Templated-Notes#3) \- Overview of Templated Notes With Notes+ (From Sidekick)
- [Section 4](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51681266670739-Understanding-Curve-Care-AI-Notes-Ambient-Appointment-Listening-for-SOAP-and-Templated-Notes#4) \- Creating Notes+ SOAP And Templated Notes From Transcription Details

**Section 1 - Overview of Notes+ Ambient Appointment Listening**

1. The Curve Care+ AI ambient voice transcription widget is located at the top of the patient's Sidekick. Its default setting is Notes+, but users should be in the habit of ensuring Notes+ is the selected feature at the beginning of a patient's appointment by clicking **Notes+**.
![CC+ Notes 1.1.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646295955)

2\. To enable ambient listening for the duration of a patient's appointment, click **Start Notes+**. This enables Curve Care+ to provide ambient listening and voice transcription of a patient's entire appointment, and will automatically pause and resume if Charting+ and Perio+ are also used during the appointment.

**Important Note:** Notes+ ambient listening has a time limit of 60 minutes.

![CC+ Notes 1.2.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646298771)

3\. Once Notes+ recording is enabled, the Sidekick will display a _Cancel Recording Session_ button, a blue active voice bar, a _Pause_ button, a _Stop_ button, a timestamp, and a red recording icon.

![AITN 2.1.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/55330294433427)

4\. To pause the recording, click the **pause button**.

![AITN 2.2.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/55330302524179)

5\. The widget will display a yellow _Paused_ icon. To resume recording, click the **Resume** button. Notes+ recording will resume.

**Note:** The overview for clicking the **Stop** button begins on **Step 9** of this section.

![AITN 2.3.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/55330302530579)

6. **Before Stopping A Recording:**

As an alternative to stopping a recording and converting the recorded data into a transcription, users can click **Cancel Recording Session** to stop recording **without saving recorded data**. This will cancel all recorded data and the data will not be saved for transcribing.

![AITN 2.5.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/55330294444691)

7\. A _Discard Recording_ dialogue box will appear, informing users that discarding the recording will lose all recorded data. To discard recording, click **Discard Recording**.

![CC+ Notes 1.9.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646304787)

8.Curve Care+ will cancel the recording and the patient's Sidekick will return to the default Curve Care+ starting point. To begin recording again with Notes+, again ensure Notes+ is selected and click **Start Notes+**. This will begin a new recording session during the patient's appointment.

![CC+ Notes 1.10.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661613971)

9\. Once a user has completed an appointment and is ready to stop recording and begin saving a transcription of the recorded data, click the **Stop** button. This will end the appointment recording. **Users should only click the Stop button if they are ready to end the recorded portion of the appointment and prepare the transcription for notes.**

![AITN 2.4.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/55330302536211)

10\. A transcription note will appear after stopping the recording letting a user know the recorded data has been successfully generated into a transcript and will now be available for creating notes.

![CC+ Notes 1.7.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646302483)

11\. Notes can be created through two different workflows:

1. Clicking **View Transcription Details** in the green _Successfully generated_ box (Section 4 of this article)
2. Clicking **Notes** in the patient's Sidekick (Sections 2 and 3)

![AISN 1.38.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53543805069203)

**Section 2 - Overview of SOAP Notes With Notes+ (From Sidekick)**

1. To access Notes+ transcribed patient appointment notes, click **Notes** in the patient's Sidekick after completing a Notes+ recording session.

**Note:** Users may return later to complete transcribed notes; they do not need to be completed immediately after recording has stopped.
![CC+ Notes 1.11.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661614355)

2\. The Notes dialogue box will open. Click **Add Templated Note**. This is the action for both SOAP notes and templated notes.

![CC+ Notes 1.12.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646305555)

3\. The _Templated Note_ dialogue box will open. To create a SOAP note, click inside the **Transcript box** (templated notes will be covered in Section 3 of this article).

![CC+ Notes 1.13.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661617939)

4\. A transcript dropdown menu will appear. Click the desired transcript.

![CC+ Notes 1.14.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661618067)

5\. To generate a SOAP note, click **Curve AI SOAP Note**.

![CC+ Notes 1.15.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661618195)

6\. A summarized SOAP note will generate from the transcription and appear in the note where users can edit the note as needed and customize the formatting of the note.

**Note:** Users must always thoroughly review the note for potential errors before saving.

![CC+ Notes 1.16.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661619859)

7\. After careful note review, click **Save**.

![CC+ Notes 1.17.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646308883)

8\. The saved SOAP note will appear in the patient's Note dialogue box.

![CC+ Notes 1.18.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646309139)

**Section 3 - Overview of Templated Notes With Notes+ (From Sidekick)**

1. To access Notes+ transcribed patient appointment notes, click **Notes** in the patient's Sidekick after completing a Notes+ recording session.

**Note:** Users may return later to complete transcribed notes; they do not need to be completed immediately after recording has stopped.
![CC+ Notes 1.11.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661614355)

2\. The Notes dialogue box will open. Click **Add Templated Note**. This is the action for both SOAP notes and templated notes.

![CC+ Notes 1.12.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646305555)

3\. The _Templated Notes_ dialogue box will open. Click the **desired note template** under the templates side panel.

![CC+ Notes 2.1.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646309651)

4\. The templated note outline will appear in the edit note section. Click the **Transcript** box.

![CC+ Notes 2.2.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646310291)

5\. A dropdown list of appointment transcripts will appear. Click **desired transcript**.

![CC+ Notes 2.3.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646310803)

6\. With the correct transcript selected, click **Complete With Curve AI**.

![CC+ Notes 2.4.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646311571)

7\. Curve Care+ Notes+ will auto-fill the templated note based on the recorded transcription. Users must always carefully review the note for any errors and must make any necessary edits to the note.

![CC+ Notes 2.6.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661626259)

8\. Once the note has been thoroughly reviewed, click the **Create** icon.

![CC+ Notes 2.5.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661626387)

9\. The note will then generate into a structured templated note. Users may still edit the note content or customize the formatting at this time.

![CC+ Notes 2.7.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661626643)

10\. After careful review and completion of any needed edits, click **Save**.

![CC+ Notes 2.8.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374661627027)

11\. The saved note will now appear in the patient's _Notes_ dialogue box.

![CC+ Notes 2.9.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53374646312851)

**Section 4 - Creating Notes+ SOAP And Templated Notes From Transcription Details**

1. After an appointment transcription has been successfully generated, click **View Transcription Details** in the green _Successfully generated_ box.

**Important Note:** This box will only retrieve the patient's most recent appointment transcription. If a patient had two appointments in one week, it will only retrieve the most recent transcription. It will also only retrieve transcriptions through the end of the working week, typically the Saturday morning following the end of a week. It will then reset and transcriptions will not be able to be generated after the reset.
![AISN 1.39.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53543805070483)

2\. A _Transcription details_ dialogue box will open with a full transcription of the recorded appointment. Users can click **Create AI Templated Note** or **Create AI SOAP Note**.

![AISN 1.40.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53543805072787)

3\. When selecting **Create AI Templated Note**, a Templated Note dialogue box will open. It will automatically use the transcript from the recently generated transcript that users clicked for _View Transcription Details_.

**Note:** To complete a templated note with Curve Care+ AI, users can follow the process outlined in **Section 3, Steps #3-11**.

![AISN 1.41.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53543805073299)

4\. Notes created from this transcript will be automatically attached to the visit with an _AI Auto Link_.

![AISN 1.42.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53543842715027)

5\. Example of the **AI Auto Link** attached to the visit:

![AISN 1.43.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53543842716435)

6\. When selecting **Create AI SOAP Note**, Curve Care+ will automatically generate the SOAP note for that transcription. Users do **not** need to click _Curve AI SOAP Note_, and can simply review the note and make any edits if necessary.

![AISN 1.44.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53543805078547)

7\. After completing review, click **Save**.

![AISN 1.45.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53543842719251)
